title: The Smooth surface of the stone
subtitle: 旅行见闻 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）
meta: 主题语境：旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）　|　核心词汇：smooth　|　正文 337 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 smooth 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1952 the teacher wrote of ① a smooth surface of the stone in the notebook, and everybody in the classroom said at once that it was ② smoother than the one named there the year before. Three terms on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the teacher, who never explained anything, had done it in the rain and gone home; it was the smooth ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the smoothest surface of the stone anybody in the classroom had ever seen, or so the notebook for March 1946 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too smooth to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the pupil who had come to help; the smooth ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the ruler at the far blackboard, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a smooth journey to the coast, and said that no pupil in his right mind would call it ⑥ as smooth as the journey to the coast they had once had in the old classroom. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was smooth or not, and he said so.

By 1959 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the notebook. What the line asked for was ⑦ something smooth, and nothing besides. The pupil from the next classroom called the whole plan ⑧ quite smooth; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the notebook kept the names of the smooth ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1962, without complaint, she wrote of another smooth surface of the stone in the same notebook, and the work, which took two terms, seemed ⑨ smoother than anybody had expected. ⑩ The smoothest journey to the coast in the whole classroom, she said in 1964, was the one she could never quite name; the smooth ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 平滑（前置定语 a smooth surface of the stone：1952 年先生在笔记簿里记下的那件平滑的表面）
B. adj. 平滑／顺利（比较级 smoother than：文中两处，一处比石头平滑的表面，一处比预想）
C. adj. 平滑／顺利（最高级 the smoothest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 平滑（表语 too smooth to do：母亲觉得它太平滑，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 顺利（前置定语 a smooth journey to the coast：叔叔把整件事称作一桩顺利的旅程）
F. adj. 顺利（同级比较 as smooth as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩去海边顺利的旅程相比）
G. adj. 顺利（后置定语 something smooth：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 顺利（受程度副词修饰 quite smooth：那位学童的评价）

items.q: a smooth surface of the stone
the smoothest surface of the stone anybody
a smooth journey to the coast
The smoothest journey to the coast in

answers.why: smooth 意为“平滑”，1952 年先生在笔记簿里记下的是“一件平滑的表面”，此处作前置定语 a smooth surface of the stone。
smooth 意为“平滑”，此处用比较级 smoother than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
smooth 意为“平滑”，笔记簿上 三月 那行字说它是教室里最平滑的一件，故用最高级 the smoothest surface of the stone。
smooth 意为“平滑”，母亲认为这件东西“太平滑了，谁也用不上”，too smooth to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
smooth 意为“顺利”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩顺利的旅程”，此处作前置定语 a smooth journey to the coast。
smooth 意为“顺利”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩去海边顺利的旅程一样顺利”，同级比较用 as smooth as。
smooth 意为“顺利”，笔记簿上那半行字要的是“顺利的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something smooth。
smooth 意为“顺利”，邻教室来的那位学童认为这套计划“相当顺利”，quite 修饰原级 smooth。
smooth 意为“顺利”，1962 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要顺利”，故用比较级 smoother than。
smooth 意为“顺利”，母亲 1964 年说的是“整个教室里最顺利的那一桩”，故用最高级 the smoothest journey to the coast。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1952 年，先生在笔记簿里记下了一件平滑的表面。（a smooth surface of the stone）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更平滑。（smoother than …）
母亲觉得它太平滑，谁也用不上。（too smooth to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩顺利的旅程。（a smooth journey to the coast）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩去海边顺利的旅程一样顺利。（as smooth as …）
到了 1959 年，笔记簿上只剩半行字：要的是一件顺利的东西。（something smooth）
answers: In 1952 the teacher wrote of a smooth surface of the stone in the notebook.
Everybody said it was smoother than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too smooth to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a smooth journey to the coast.
He said nobody would call it as smooth as the journey to the coast they had once had.
By 1959 the notebook asked for nothing but something smooth.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 smooth 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1952 the teacher wrote of a smooth surface of the stone in the notebook, and nobody forgot it.
It was the smoothest surface of the stone in the classroom, or so the notebook says.
My mother thought it too smooth to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a smooth journey to the coast, and nobody argued with him.
The pupil from the next classroom called the plan quite smooth, and everybody laughed.
The smooth ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
